title: Inquest starts today; Died in APD custody in 2008
article: The BC Coroner's service has scheduled a formal inquest today thru Friday to look into the in-custody death of an Abbotsford woman in 2008.

Christine Bernadette Miller, 39, was pronounced dead Aug. 8, 2008 after being rushed to Matsqui-Sumas-Abbotsford General Hospital following her arrest and incarceration in an Abbotsford Police Department holding cell on Aug. 7, 2008.

According to a spokesperson at the Ministry of Public Safety and Solicitor General, coroner Vincent Stancato will preside over the inquest with a jury present to publicly hear evidence from subpoenaed witnesses in order to determine the facts surrounding Miller's death.
w The inquest takes place at the Coroners Court at 4720 Kingsway in Burnaby.
